meta.name: executing-plans
meta.description: Use when you have a written implementation plan to execute in a separate session with review checkpoints

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按计划分步执行代码任务并自动审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有实现计划需要分步执行并确保质量
copy.tagline_en: Execute implementation plans step by step with review checkpoints
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a written plan to execute with quality checkpoints

howto.what: Claude 会加载一个书面实施计划，按批次执行任务，每完成一批后报告进度并等待反馈，直到所有任务完成。
howto.when: 当你有一个书面实施计划需要执行，且希望分批次执行并在每批后获得审查时触发。

say.text: 请加载我的实施计划并开始执行。
say.note: Claude 会读取计划文件并开始执行。

say.text: 执行计划的前三个任务。
say.note: Claude 会执行默认批次（前3个任务）。

say.text: 报告当前批次的执行结果。
say.note: Claude 会展示已实现内容和验证输出。

howto.what_en: Claude loads a written implementation plan, executes tasks in batches, reports progress after each batch, and waits for feedback until all tasks are complete.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have a written implementation plan to execute in a separate session with review checkpoints between batches.

say_en.text: Please load my implementation plan and start executing.
say_en.note: Claude will read the plan file and begin execution.

say_en.text: Execute the first three tasks of the plan.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the default batch (first 3 tasks).

say_en.text: Report the results of the current batch.
say_en.note: Claude will show what was implemented and verification output.
